name: Arista AVD
description: Isolated managed Python, matching PyAVD and Ansible collections, and optional contributor tooling.

mode.description: Released runtime, inventory development tools, or editable AVD source.

version.description: Exact stable AVD >=6.4.0,<7.0.0, or latest stable release common to PyPI and Galaxy (runtime/tools).

pythonVersion.description: Managed CPython minor or exact patch. Auto: 3.14 runtime/tools, 3.12 source. Runtime/tools: 3.12–3.14; source: 3.12–3.13.

sourcePath.description: Workspace repository root relative to post-create working directory, or absolute path (source/workspace).

sourceRepository.description: HTTPS or SSH Git location without embedded credentials (source/git).

sourceRef.description: Branch, tag, or commit to resolve (source/git).

installCommunityGeneral.description: Add a community.general version compatible with the controller's Ansible.

installSshSupport.description: Add paramiko and ansible-pylibssh client transports; does not provide an SSH server.
